messages:
Ravi S: Heads-up: launching a compact 2-email welcome + webinar invite flow for new signups. Target KPIs: increase 7-day retention by 6% and webinar sign-through by 18%.

Lina M: Can we segment by product signal? Propose segments: 'Active Integrators' (webhook/reg interest), 'Free Trialers' (<10 API calls/day), 'Docs Browsers' (visited quickstart/docs page).

Clara B: Subject line candidates (short):
- "Start serving faster with Redwood"
- "Join our quick inference workshop (wk2)"
- "Your Redwood account: 2 steps to speed"
Let's test urgency vs value.

Owen: Suggested send windows by region: NA 9-11am PT, EU 10-12 CET, APAC 8-10 SGT. Add timezone-aware throttling to avoid spikes.

marketing-bot: Note: compliance check flagged link shortener on creative doc. Use full URLs.

Ravi S: Flow outline:
1) Day 0: Welcome email (benefits + quickstart link + CTA to schedule demo/webinar)
2) Day 3: Invite to webinar (how-to, deep-dive), or alternate: short 1-question survey for Docs Browsers.

Lina M: Also propose a Canary microcohort (5% of signups) to test subject variants and CTA phrasing. Track opens, clicks, demo signups.

Clara B: Copy owner = me. Will prepare 2 variants per segment. Need final segment definitions by EOD.

Owen: Routing rule: if user has enterprise tag, send Dedicated CTA variant with enterprise webinar link.

Ravi S: Action items: Clara write copy, Lina finalize segment flags in CRM, Owen config send windows & throttling, I'll set UTM params and dashboard for metrics. Sync tomorrow 10am PT.

marketing-bot: Reminder: create email test labels in ESP before scheduling.

Ravi S: Also: Can we include a small incentive in the invite (early access to benchmark report) for Core 'Active Integrators'? Thoughts?

Lina M: Good idea but limit to Enterprise & Core to avoid overpromising.

Clara B: I'll bake that into variant B for Core only.

Owen: All right, I'll prepare the send config.

Ravi S: Thanks team, schedule looks tight but doable. Meeting tomorrow 10am PT. :rocket:
